['E.Dis AG '].company_description: E.Dis AG is a company that was formed in 1990 by the merger of Nixdorf Computer and the Data Information Services (DIS) division of Siemens. It functioned as a separate company within Siemens and was the largest information technology company in Europe until 1999, when it was split into two: Fujitsu Siemens Computers and Wincor Nixdorf. Wincor Nixdorf took over all banking and retail related business.

['Saarstahl AG '].company_description: Saarstahl AG is one of the most significant manufacturers of long products in the world, with production locations in Völklingen, Burbach, and Neunkirchen. The company is known for producing high-quality steel products and has a strong focus on quality, efficiency, and environmental compatibility. Saarstahl has been recognized for its CSR management and is committed to sustainability standards and certification in the steel industry.
